ideas.pitch: A real-time routing and fill-level monitoring system for municipal waste bins in Jammu to optimize garbage truck collection routes.
ideas.title: JammuCleanRoute: Dynamic Waste Collection Fleet Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses municipal pain points directly with a working route-optimization dashboard, echoing the real-world impact and live council dashboard pattern seen in winning civic tech hacks.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered geospatial audit tool that analyzes satellite imagery and crowd-sourced geo-tags to assess green space coverage and public park maintenance needs in Jammu.
ideas.title: TawiGreen: Urban Canopy and Public Realm Health Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines visual data processing with concrete metrics on urban green cover, aligning with municipal sustainability goals and providing judges with a clear visual demonstration.

ideas.pitch: A localized LLM-powered triage platform that clusters citizen-reported urban infrastructure faults and automatically routes them to the correct Jammu municipal ward authority.
ideas.title: JammuUrbanPulse: Citizen-Driven Civic Grievance & Ward Planning Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages agentic workflow patterns and text classification to solve administrative bottlenecks, matching the practical utility prized in civic challenge hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A walk-to-earn mobile web app that incentivizes citizens to report illegal dumping sites and verify neighborhood cleanliness drives through geo-stamped photos.
ideas.title: CleanJammu Audit: Neighborhood Cleanliness Scoring and Reward App
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the gamified walk-to-earn community engagement model of past real-world impact winners, making local governance interactive for residents.

ideas.pitch: A sensor-mocking and predictive dashboard that forecasts urban waterlogging hot spots during heavy rains in Jammu using topographical data and weather APIs.
ideas.title: EcoDrain Jammu: Flood and Waterlogging Early Warning System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous time-series forecasting and risk-calibration techniques to real municipal geography, echoing the predictive accuracy valued in top forecasting hacks.
